failures.message: collected at head and failed there — Given the resolver `end_review.branch_heads` builds, `run_end_review` opens each layer's cell, and the join's, at the head the layer's branch carries when the end review runs. Each lens's diff and stated range start at the base the rule picks. The witness drives each arm of the rule. A layer with no predecessor starts at its merge base with the freshly fetched default branch, when its pushed head's parent is an ancestor of that merge base and the merge base does not contain the pushed head. Otherwise it starts at its pushed head's parent. Three bottom layers are driven. One is unrebased. One was rebased onto a newer default branch, whose commit stays out of the layer's diff and the join's. The default branch already contains the third, which is graded from its pushed head's parent, not as an empty diff. A restacked layer starts at its predecessor's current head, which outranks the recorded one. A layer that was not restacked starts at its predecessor's recorded head. A layer whose predecessor's branch is gone starts at its own pushed head's parent when its head contains it, else at the predecessor's recorded head when contained. The witness drives a stack base whose branch is gone and whose review commit was pushed after its own PACKAGE, and that review commit stays out of the layer's diff. The join reads from the bottom layer's base to the top layer's current head. Each layer's branch, each predecessor's branch and the default branch is fetched once per end review when the fetch succeeds. `StackReview.fields` holds every layer either walk resolved. The witness drives a stack whose join ran while the reserve stopped the layer walk, and a one-layer stack with no join. An unmoved stack still reads `head^..head` per layer.

names nothing the suite ran at head — `saffron batch --stack` hands `run_end_review` the resolver `branch_heads` builds on the pinned mirror and the pinned url. Asked for a layer, it fetches that layer's branch there and grades the fetched head. Each end review builds its own resolver, with an empty cache. The witness runs the end review twice, with the branch moved between the two, and each grades the head fetched for it.
